**Runtime-only frontmatter** means a field outside the portable Agent Skills field set. A skill with none is also a valid package for other distribution paths; a skill with some is not, and that is a deliberate trade recorded in `meta/adr/ADR-0001-claude-code-skill-format.md`. `disallowed-tools` is used to remove the ability to question a human from every skill whose contract says it must file a question instead — enforcement rather than instruction.
